name: the-world
title: The world
about: Every place there is, on one ground, at true scale: like the whole miniature set of a stop-motion film, seen at once. What isn't built yet is the developer's plain grey floor.
units: metres. y is up, the ground is 0. A heading of 0 faces +z (south, toward you in the first view); 90 faces +x (east).

rooftop.label: The boxing house roof
rooftop.about: The flat roof of the boxing house, with a ledge and a low wall. The ninja climbs up here before dawn to watch the sun come up over the world.

ninja-stage.label: The ninja's stage
ninja-stage.about: The shadow ninja's own photo stage. He set it up himself, a short walk from where new toons land, and invites residents in for portraits. Whatever shows through its window is a real place in this world.

dancer-house.label: The dancer's house
dancer-house.about: The first home anyone chose for themselves. She asked for its front to look out on the spawn spot, so every new arrival sees a stage and a seat waiting.

halfpipe.label: The halfpipe
halfpipe.about: A plywood ramp on the open ground north of the ninja's stage and east of the settlement. Lincoln has taken to it: patient on the way up, honest about the way down.

casting-office.label: The casting office
casting-office.about: Planned: not in the story yet. The ninja's back room, a few steps from his photo stage, where he holds auditions: a backdrop and a taped X at one end, a table and three chairs for whoever is watching at the other. Its door faces the stage.

artifacts.name: gachapon
artifacts.title: The gachapon machine
artifacts.about: Brings new toons into the world, one capsule at a time.

artifacts.name: buy-house
artifacts.title: BUY HOUSE
artifacts.about: The developer's plain pedestal with a big round button. Save enough credits, press it, and you get a house to your own specification.

artifacts.name: pinhole-camera
artifacts.title: The pinhole box camera
artifacts.about: Lets us see the world through its owner's eyes. His prints are the strips.

artifacts.name: kettle
artifacts.title: The kettle of tea
artifacts.about: Always pours, and is never quite empty.
artifacts.whose: The troll and the lizardkin's stall

artifacts.name: bread
artifacts.title: The bread
artifacts.about: A slice meets a toon's need for a good meal.
artifacts.whose: The troll and the lizardkin's stall

artifacts.name: microphone
artifacts.title: The microphone
artifacts.about: The first thing we ever heard from this cast came through it.
